summary: Four teenagers on dirt bikes stuck in blowdown at Cross Creek without proper gear, water and low on fuel; six RGCSAR members responded by ATV with chainsaws, cut 20+ trees to clear the trail and brought them to safety by ~10pm.
responding_agency: Rio Grande County Search and Rescue
notes: Memorial Day mission; contacted ~6pm, ended ~10pm. Run 667 merge: Miner June-6-2024 print-edition PDF (Vol.47 No.23) carries the same story ("RGC Search and Rescue aids teens stuck in blowdown", Memorial Day May 27, Cross Creek).
